text:
Type: large block-check flatwoven rug
Use: anchoring a living or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, contemporary
Materials: flatwoven wool-like yarn
Colors: dark chocolate brown, taupe, slate blue-grey, black, light beige, lilac grey
Shape: rectangular, flat, rows of color blocks in a symmetric patchwork grid, crisp edges, large and grounding
Feel: warm, structured, earthy, calm
Goes with: walnut or oak wood, leather, grey sofas, brass accents; Scandinavian, mid-century or modern living rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: Handwoven by skilled craftspeople, each one is unique. Made in India in organised weaving centres with good working conditions and fair wages.
